note: This is a deliberately selected demonstration set, not a prevalence estimate or general score of SDK quality. Addresses are placeholders because these probes compile only.

results.title: A valid Payment is accepted
results.source:
import type { Payment } from 'xrpl';
const payment = { TransactionType: 'Payment', Account: 'rSource', Destination: 'rDestination', Amount: '100', DestinationTag: 12 } satisfies Payment;

results.title: Misspelled optional transaction fields are rejected
results.source:
import type { Payment } from 'xrpl';
const payment = { TransactionType: 'Payment', Account: 'rSource', Destination: 'rDestination', Amount: '100', DestinationTagg: 12 } satisfies Payment;

diagnostics.message: Object literal may only specify known properties, but 'DestinationTagg' does not exist in type 'Payment'. Did you mean to write 'DestinationTag'?

results.title: Misspelled request fields are rejected
results.source:
import type { AccountInfoRequest } from 'xrpl';
const request = { command: 'account_info', account: 'rSource', ledger_indx: 'validated' } satisfies AccountInfoRequest;

diagnostics.message: Object literal may only specify known properties, but 'ledger_indx' does not exist in type 'AccountInfoRequest'. Did you mean to write 'ledger_index'?

results.title: Omitting Account preserves other required Payment fields
results.source:
import type { Payment } from 'xrpl';
const incomplete: Omit<Payment, 'Account'> = { TransactionType: 'Payment' };

diagnostics.message: Type '{ TransactionType: "Payment"; }' is missing the following properties from type 'Omit<Payment, "Account">': Destination, Amount
